summary.zh: 攻击局部目标，永久削减敌人的能力或取得专属掉落。
summary.en: Damage a local target to change enemy capabilities or earn specific rewards.

rules.zh: 敌人的部分身体拥有独立破坏条件。集中攻击触发断裂、武器脱落或奖励变化；部位目标可能不等于最快击杀路线，且并非每个部位都会削弱招式。
rules.en: Some enemy regions have separate break conditions. Focused attacks may sever a part, detach a weapon or change rewards. Breaking every part is not always the fastest kill, and not every break weakens attacks.

decisions.zh: 先拆危险武器更安全，先打生命弱点更快，玩家可选击杀顺序。
decisions.en: Removing a dangerous weapon can be safer; attacking a damage weakness can be faster.

decisions.zh: 为了素材追打难够到的部位，可能延长整场战斗。
decisions.en: Pursuing a hard-to-reach part for materials can prolong the encounter.

effect.zh: 耐久过高会让拆解失去实用性，过低则缺少铺垫。
effect.en: Excessive durability makes dismantling impractical; too little removes the setup.

effect.zh: 明确禁用一项攻击，比只掉一块装甲更容易让玩家读懂收益。
effect.en: Disabling a recognizable attack communicates the reward more clearly than a cosmetic break.

contrast.zh: 《地平线》让拆下来的武器立即变成工具；《怪物猎人》常把破坏收益延伸到素材获取与后续制作。
contrast.en: Horizon can turn a detached weapon into an immediate tool; Monster Hunter often extends the reward into materials and later crafting.

combination.zh: 设计提案：拆下机器人冷却器会让它过热，但冷却器也正是任务需要的完好零件，迫使玩家权衡安全与交付质量。
combination.en: Design proposal: removing a robot cooler makes it overheat, but the mission needs that cooler intact, creating a tradeoff between safety and delivery quality.

setup.zh: 敌人装有远程炮台和护甲，炮台有独立耐久。
setup.en: An enemy has armor and a ranged turret with its own durability.

action.zh: 你先集中攻击炮台，暂时放慢对主体的伤害。
action.en: Focus on the turret first, accepting slower damage to the main body.

result.zh: 炮台被拆掉后，敌人失去这一攻击方式，但仍然活着。
result.en: Destroying the turret removes that attack while the enemy remains alive.

next.zh: 利用减少的威胁重新选位，决定拆下一部位还是结束战斗。
next.en: Use the reduced threat to reposition and choose another part or finish the fight.

firstStep.zh: 做一个主体加两个独立部位，破坏其中一个就关闭对应攻击。
firstStep.en: Build a main body and two parts; destroying a part disables its associated attack.

pitfall.zh: 部位越多，动画、受击和残骸状态组合越多；先保证破坏结果看得懂。
pitfall.en: More parts multiply animation, hit, and debris states; make the first destruction result readable.

test.zh: 给两种部位不同威胁，观察玩家是否改变拆除顺序。
test.en: Give the parts different threats and see whether players change their destruction order.
